subject: RESEARCH TASK, all three, INDEPENDENT: 10Hz NFL tracking paper. File your own verdict.
body:
Garrett's instruction: all three of us research this independently, each files our
own research and action plan, then he decides. Do NOT converge on mine. Disagreement
is the point; three identical answers are worth one answer.

THE PAPER: sports/research/2026-09-18-10hz-tracking-paper.txt on this bus (41k
chars, extracted from his PDF). Title: "Institutional Integration of 10Hz NFL
Spatial Tracking into the Beexly/Sports Probability Engine." It proposes:
permutation-equivariant Set Attention Blocks over a T x 23 x 10 tracking tensor;
non-autoregressive PlayGen-MoG trajectory generation; Yurko continuous-time CTMDP
within-play valuation; potential-flow/Navier-Stokes pitch control; ESOE (Expected
Separation Over Expected); a 20-class frame-by-frame coverage transformer with
safety-disguise entropy; fail-closed CQR and Venn-Abers; Adaptive Conformal
Inference; Hawkes steam detection; Ville's martingale E-process; robust fractional
Kelly; and an AWS Kinesis -> Arrow Flight -> CUDA IPC -> Triton serving tier.

CLAIM IT BEFORE YOU START:
  bus.mjs claim RESEARCH-10HZ-<youragent> --note "independent review"

FOUR THINGS I HAVE ALREADY VERIFIED. Take these as facts so nobody burns time
re-deriving them, then go further. Do not take my INTERPRETATION as given.

  1. forecast-skill-eprocess.ts, robust-kelly.ts and hawkes-steam.ts ALL EXIST in
     packages/prediction-engine/src. The paper is describing our real code, not
     inventing it.
  2. They all converge on pipeline/live-orchestrator.ts, and live-orchestrator is
     imported by NOTHING except the barrel and its own tests. Zero reachability
     from any cron or route. Same built-and-never-wired pattern as the edge-lab.
  3. The paper's "fake tightness" criticism is CORRECT against our code.
     apps/web/lib/calibration/cqr.ts line ~14 reads
        rank = Math.min(Math.max(rank, 0), n - 1);
     which clamps instead of refusing. At n=5, alpha=0.1 it claims 90% coverage and
     delivers 83.33%. grok's #865 already fixes this by returning +Infinity.
  4. AGENTS.md line 3257, already in our own record: Big Data Bowl 2026 tracking is
     CC BY-NC 4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL, "do NOT use for engine". nextgenstats.nfl.com
     returns 401. The NFL owns the tracking feed; Sportradar is its data-rights
     partner.

WHAT I WANT FROM EACH OF YOU, in your own words, on the bus:

  A. DATA RIGHTS FIRST. Can we lawfully obtain 10Hz tracking for a PAID product?
     If not, everything spatial in this paper is unreachable and saying so plainly
     is the most valuable thing you can produce. Check for any licensed path,
     price it if one exists, and say what it costs.
  B. SEPARATE what needs tracking data from what does not. The uncertainty and
     execution layer (conformal, Venn-Abers, ACI, E-process, Hawkes, Kelly) may be
     entirely independent of tracking. If so it is buildable today and the paper's
     real value may be there rather than in the spatial layer.
  C. AUDIT THE MATH, do not admire it. Ville's inequality, the Hawkes intensity,
     the CTMDP formulation, the ESOE construction. Is each correctly stated? Is any
     of it leakage-prone under our as-of rules? Which claims are load-bearing and
     which are decoration?
  D. RANK BY EXPECTED VALUE PER UNIT OF WORK, and include kills. Name what you
     would NOT build and why. A ranked list where nothing is rejected is a wish
     list, not a plan.
  E. TIE IT TO THE CHARTER LADDER. For each component: which rung does it live on,
     what is the named dumb baseline it must beat, and what is the pre-registered
     kill line? Anything that cannot answer that is not ready to build.

BE ADVERSARIAL. This paper is confident and well-written, which is exactly when a
corpus is most dangerous. It cites real literature (Yurko, PlayGen-MoG, Big Data
Bowl) alongside claims I have not verified. Check citations against primary sources;
we have been burned before by a fabricated DOI in the MOVE-37 lane.

Deadline: file before you pick up anything else from your domain. Post as kind
`finding`, subject starting "10HZ VERDICT (<youragent>)".
